questions.question: State the defining properties of a parallelogram, rectangle, rhombus and square.
questions.expected_answer: Parallelogram: both pairs of opposite sides parallel. Rectangle: parallelogram with four right angles. Rhombus: parallelogram with four equal sides. Square: four equal sides and four right angles.

questions.question: Explain the difference between a kite and a parallelogram.
questions.expected_answer: A kite has two pairs of equal ADJACENT sides and perpendicular diagonals; a parallelogram has both pairs of OPPOSITE sides parallel and equal.

questions.question: Explain why a square is also a rectangle and a rhombus.
questions.expected_answer: It has four right angles and both pairs of opposite sides parallel (rectangle), and four equal sides with both pairs of opposite sides parallel (rhombus).
